svg.text: 10 October 2026 · solid green = implemented RTL · dashed blue = planned · widths / capacities provisional

g.title: core_ctrl.mem → clients[0] Requester → responder: req_valid, req{write[1],bank[5],addr[32],format[2],wdata[96]}, rsp_ready. Responder → requester: req_ready, rsp_valid, rsp_rdata[96], rsp_error. Native-element address. Unused high write bits zero. Read extension depends on native signedness. Write acknowledgement after commitment. Client index 0; only client 0 writes PARAM/MASK; compute accesses otherwise follow bank ownership.

parameters → access [bank=0 PARAM] Requester → responder: req_valid, req{write[1],bank[5],addr[32],format[2],wdata[96]}, rsp_ready. Responder → requester: req_ready, rsp_valid, rsp_rdata[96], rsp_error. Native-element address. Unused high write bits zero. Read extension depends on native signedness. Write acknowledgement after commitment. One global transaction; owner retained until response. Validation before dispatch.

scratch → access [banks=1…17] Requester → responder: req_valid, req{write[1],bank[5],addr[32],format[2],wdata[96]}, rsp_ready. Responder → requester: req_ready, rsp_valid, rsp_rdata[96], rsp_error. Native-element address. Unused high write bits zero. Read extension depends on native signedness. Write acknowledgement after commitment. BANK_DEPTHS[18] explicitly configured; zero disables. Invalid request returns local error and never reaches storage.

bank 0 · PARAM Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. PARAM_WORDS, signed16/F10; producer: Core host loader while idle; consumer: Position, LayerNorm, linear bias reads, dot weight reads
bank 1 · FEATURE Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*F, signed16/F10; producer: Core feature loader; consumer: Embedding copy loop
bank 2 · MASK Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, bit; producer: Core mask loader; consumer: Attention query flag; aggregation
bank 3 · X Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: Embedding, position, residual; consumer: Position, LayerNorm, residual, final dot
bank 4 · U Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: LayerNorm 1, then LayerNorm 2 after residual 1; consumer: Q/K/V dot, then FFN dot
bank 5 · Q Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: Q linear; consumer: Score dot
bank 6 · KEY Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: K linear; consumer: Score dot
bank 7 · VALUE Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: V linear; consumer: Weighted dot
bank 8 · Z Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: Weighted controller; consumer: Output-projection dot
bank 9 · ATTN_OUT Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: Output-projection linear; consumer: First residual
bank 10 · TOKEN Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. max(F,D), signed16/F10; producer: Embedding copy, input LayerNorm; consumer: LayerNorm, embedding dot

bank 11 · FFN_HIDDEN Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. 4D, signed16/F10; producer: First FFN linear, then in-place GELU write loop; consumer: GELU read loop, then second FFN linear's dot

bank 12 · VECTOR Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. max(D,4D), signed16/F10; producer: Embedding linear/LN; second FFN linear; consumer: Embedding copy/LN, second residual
bank 13 · SCORE Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, signed48/F20; producer: Score controller; consumer: Softmax
bank 14 · EXP Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, unsigned24/F22; producer: Softmax; consumer: Softmax
bank 15 · PROB Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, unsigned24/F22; producer: Softmax; consumer: Weighted dot
bank 16 · LOGIT Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, signed16/F10; producer: Final linear; consumer: Aggregation
bank 17 · OUTPUT Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. N, signed16/F10; producer: Aggregation; consumer: Core output transfer

| core_ctrl | Host loading, image/frame validity, stage sequence, output transfer, completion code | All N output transfers accepted, or one held error report | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| embedding_ctrl | Token loop, FEATURE-to-TOKEN copy, norm/linear/norm calls, VECTOR-to-X copy | All X writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| position_ctrl | m/n/feature loops, P/E reads, widened additions/conversions | All enriched X writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| attention_ctrl | QKV phase, head/query loops, query-mask read, score/softmax/weighted sequence, output projection | All ATTN_OUT writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| layernorm_ctrl | Statistics passes, RSQRT, affine pass, conversion and writes | Every normalized output write acknowledged | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| linear_ctrl | Output loop, bias read, dot descriptor, conversion, destination write | Every output write acknowledged | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| score_row_ctrl | Key loop for one fixed head/query, dot/scale, SCORE writes | One complete L-element score row committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| softmax_ctrl | Max pass, exp/store/sum pass, reciprocal, probability write pass or uniform bypass | All L probability writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
| weighted_value_ctrl | Feature loop within fixed head/query, probability-by-V dots | d Z components committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
| ffn_ctrl | First linear, 4D GELU read/replace loop, second linear | D VECTOR outputs committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| residual_ctrl | Element loop, capture both operands, add/convert/write | All requested destination sums committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| aggregation_ctrl | n/m loops, per-position sum/count, reciprocal/scale, private output writes | All N writes committed, or typed empty-position/fatal response | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| dot_engine | Term loop, two reads, MAC request/result, wide accumulator | Wide result held; it never writes the caller's destination | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
Implemented protocol RTL; retained transaction owner, one outstanding request, lowest-index arbitration, stable responses until accepted.

Implemented behavioral RTL adapter. Native-width storage; IDLE -> WAIT_ACCESS -> RESPONSE; RESPONSE_DELAY >=1; successful write response follows commitment. Reset cancels pending access, retains committed words. Depth defaults zero and must be configured. Physical SRAM implementation unresolved.

Implemented behavioral RTL adapter. Native-width storage; IDLE -> WAIT_ACCESS -> RESPONSE; RESPONSE_DELAY >=1; successful write response follows commitment. Reset cancels pending access, retains committed words. Depth defaults zero and must be configured. Physical SRAM implementation unresolved.
